title: Understanding the Model

title: Linear Independence
text: If the columns of the design matrix are linearly independent, it means there is no linear relationship among them. This ensures that the matrix is full rank.

title: Unique Solution
text: A full rank matrix implies that the OLS solution is unique. This is because the inverse of the matrix exists, allowing for a unique solution to the normal equations.
